data.rationale: The proposal follows the same sequence (caniuse lookup, MDN search and URL, compose reply with the right subject and body), but it has no customer parameter (it uses recipient_email, with inconsistent {recipient} and {name} placeholders, and the true To address is {customer}@example.com). It is also vague about the tabs, leaves "Send or discard" ambiguous when the true workflow says never send and to discard, omits closing the MDN tab, and doesn't cover the unsupported-browser case.
